2609.40303.title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
2609.40303.paper_summary: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.
2609.40303.paper_summary_zh: 最近的自主機器學習工程（MLE）代理在公共排行榜上取得了顯著進展。這些進展通常是由於在長期週期中的進展停滯和有限的大型語言模型（LLM）原語所驅動，現代MLE代理被部署在越來越複雜的機械上：多代理協調器、專用檢索子代理等。儘管這些裝置在擴展，但對於使用更原始但改進的編碼代理——在這種情況下LLM可以通過讀取、寫入和bash原語直接訪問執行環境——在該領域卻鮮有關注。在本文中，我們發現，在相同的時間預算和相同的前沿LLM主幹下，開源的最新狀態裝置並未提供比最小化裝置編碼代理基準的單次會話更大的優勢，這表明主幹是性能的主要驅動因素。通過一系列大規模的系統性消融研究，我們認為在編碼代理設置中，機械層變得多餘。我們總結道，花費在強模型周圍精心設計的裝置上的努力，對當前MLE基準的回報甚微。
